content: Hikɨ Tsauru 'iyarieya 'aixɨa pɨ'anekai 'Etsitewani mumieriekɨ. Tsauru memɨyutixexeɨriwa kemɨtiwataweweiyakai Hikɨ 'ana Kerutsaremetsie memɨyutixexeɨriwakai waɨkawamekɨ mekaneutaweiyariexɨani memu'uximatɨariekaikɨ, yunaitɨ mekaneutayeixɨani naitsarie kiekari mukumanetsie Kureyatsie meta Tsamariyatsie, nɨ'ariekate xeikɨa mekaniuyuhayewa.
Hipatɨ teɨteri Kakaɨyari memayexeiyakai 'Etsitewani mekanekuteuku, waɨkawamekɨ meyuhiwerietɨ hetsiena mieme.
Tsauru kwini mieme pɨwa'uximatɨakai memɨyutixexeɨriwakai: wakiita peutahakekai, warayehapanatɨ 'ukitsi 'ukari kaniwaranutaxɨrɨwakaitɨni.
Niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne Tsamariyatsie kemɨtikuxaxatsiwakai
Hikɨ memeutaxɨriexɨa naitsarie mekaneutayeixɨani niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne mekuxatatɨ.
Hikɨ Peripe nuaka Tsamariya kiekaritsie katiniwahekɨatɨakaitɨni Kɨritsitu heitserie mupitɨarie hepaɨtsita.
Mekani'enieni yunaitɨ kemutainekai Peripe 'axeikɨa me'i'enietɨ me'ixeiyatɨ 'inɨari kemɨtiyurienekai.
Kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene karima me'utihiwatɨ mepɨwarutixɨnaxɨ yumɨireme memɨwawiyakai. Yuwaɨkawatɨ wa'ɨkate mɨtutunikai meta memɨhurietɨkatei 'aixɨa me'anenetɨ mekanakɨne.
Mɨkɨ kiekaritsie yemekɨ mekaniyutemamawiekaitɨni.
Tsimuni tiyukewaiyame
Hikɨ xewitɨ tewi Tsimuni mɨtitewakai mana puyeikakai mɨkɨ kiekaritsie meripaitɨ wakewaiyatɨ tsamariyatari tiwa'irɨwiyatɨ mɨpaɨ putainekai kename tɨrɨkaɨyekai.
Yunaitɨ 'ukirawetsixi tɨɨri meta mepi'eniekai mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «'Ikɨ Kakaɨyari tɨrɨkariyaya kanihɨkɨtɨni, Mɨmariwe mɨtitewa».
Mepi'eniekai mɨixa mɨtiwa'irɨwiyakaikɨ wakewaiyatɨ.

Kepauka yuri memɨte'ita'eriri Peripe tiwakuxaxatɨwame niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne, kemɨti'ane Kakaɨyari ti'aitametɨkaku tikuxatatɨ, kemɨ'ane Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu mɨhɨkɨ kuxatatɨ, 'ukitsi 'ukari mepuka'ɨyarie.
Mɨkɨta Tsimuni yuri katiniuta'erieni, 'uka'ɨyarieka Peripe pɨparewiekai. 'Ixeiyatɨ 'inɨari tɨrɨkaɨyemekɨ waɨkawamekɨ kemɨtiyurienekai pɨ'iyarixiekai.
Hikɨ me'u'enanaka nɨ'ariekate Kerutsareme meme'uwakai kename tsamariyatari me'itanaki'eri Kakaɨyari niukieya, wahetsɨa mepɨwarenɨ'a Pekuru Wani hamatɨa.
Mɨkɨ meheta'axɨaka mekaniyutanenewieni wahetsiemieme 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata mehexeiyatɨ memakɨnekɨ.
'Akuxi 'Iyari mɨkɨ nixewitɨ pɨkahexeiyakai. Mepuka'ɨyariekai xeikɨa Kɨritsitu hetsɨa memɨmiemetetɨnikɨ.
Hikɨ Pekuru meta Wani wahetsie mekaneutimeni, mɨkɨ 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata mehexeiyatɨ mekanakɨne.
Hikɨ Tsimuni kaniwaruxeiya 'Iyari kememɨte'upitɨarie nɨ'ariekate waheima me'utimeku. Tumini kaniwaranu'ɨirienikekaitɨni,
mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —Xekeneneupitɨa neta 'ikɨ tɨrɨkariya, kemɨ'ane heima nemutimeni 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata hexeiyatɨ mayanikɨ.
Pekuru mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Atumini 'ahamatɨa ke'ukumawere, tuminikɨ Kakaɨyari 'imikierieya pemɨnanaimɨkɨkaikɨ.
'Ikɨ hepaɨtsita 'ekɨ heitserie pepɨkahexeiya, 'ahetsie pɨkatinakeni. 'A'iyari mɨkaheitseriekɨ Kakaɨyari hɨxie.
Ketineuhayewa kepemɨtiyuriene, pe'iku'eirieme 'ikɨ tita 'axapemɨtiyuriene, Ti'aitame keneutawawiri tsiparatsɨ xɨka pereuyehɨwiyariemɨkɨ mɨpaɨ pemɨti'akɨhɨawekɨ.
Ne nepɨmatsixeiya tsiɨrika hepaɨ pehatsiwime, tita mɨkatiheitseriekɨ penɨkame.
Hikɨ Tsimuni mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Xemetsɨ Ti'aitame xekeneutawawiri nehetsiemieme, 'atsinemɨka'itɨarienikɨ kexemutiyuane.
Hikɨ mɨkɨri mewarutahekɨatɨaka me'itaxataka Ti'aitame niukieya, ta'aurie mepaxɨri, Kerutsareme mekanekɨne. Niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne mekanikuxatakaitɨni naitsarie tsamariyatari wakiekaritetsie.
Peripe 'etihupiyatanaka hamatɨa kememɨtekuxatakai
Hikɨ Ti'aitame niukieya tuayame Peripe mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Kenanukukexi, tatserieta kenemie huyeta Kerutsareme mayehane 'utɨma kiekari Kahatsa mɨrakutewatsie mɨye'axe, hakewa makumawe».

Peripe 'anukukeka kaneyani. Tewi 'etihupiyatanaka ti'uximayatame ti'aitame hetsiemieme mɨkaneɨke kananukunake, waɨkawamekɨ mɨhɨritɨariekai 'uka ti'aitame Kanaratse mɨtitewakai hetsiemieme. Katinihɨritɨariekaitɨni naime piiniteya hepaɨtsita. Mɨkɨ tewi Kerutsareme kanekuyeixɨakaitɨni heyukunenewieka,
yukaxetatsie hatikaitɨ, titerɨwatɨ tixaxatame Kitsariyaxi xapaya.
Kakaɨyari 'Iyarieya Peripe mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Mana kenemie, 'ahurawa keneuye'a mɨkɨ kaxeta 'aurie».
Peripe 'unautsarɨmetɨ, kani'enieni tixaxatame Kitsariyaxi xapaya terɨwakame. Mɨpaɨ katinita'iwawiya: —¿Pereiti'enietɨyeika 'aku tita pemɨtiterɨwa?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —¿Ketsɨnereitimani, xɨka xewitɨ kanetsi'utahekɨatɨani? Hikɨ Peripe kaniuta'inieni manutimakekɨ, 'auriena mayerɨnikɨ.
Mɨpaɨ panuyɨne 'utɨarika pemiterɨwakai:

content.text: Tixaɨ mɨkaratɨakɨ, heitserie pɨka'upitɨarie kemɨreuyewekai kepauka muta'inɨatsie.

content: Hikɨ tewi mɨhɨritɨarie Peripe mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Yakenetineutaxatɨa 'ekɨ ximɨxi, ¿kepaikɨ pɨraxata tixaxatame, pɨyuxata, nutsu xeime pɨta pɨxata?
Hikɨ Peripe, kanitsutɨani mɨkɨ 'utɨarikatsie tihekɨatɨatɨ tikuxaxatɨwatɨ niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne Ketsutsi hepaɨtsita.
Huyeta me'uhutɨ haa maxuawe mekaniu'axɨani, mɨpaɨ tewi mɨhɨritɨarie kaniutayɨni: —Neuxei kamɨ haa 'ena. ¿Titari reuyewetse nemɨka'ɨyarienikɨ?
Mɨpaɨ Peripe katinita'eiya: —Xɨka 'a'iyaritsie yemekɨ yuri peti'erieka, 'aixɨa kaniyɨmɨkɨ. Mɨkɨta mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Ne yuri nekatini'erieka Kakaɨyari Nu'aya Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu mɨhɨkɨ.
Katiniuta'aita kaxeta mana mɨtakerienikɨ. Yuhutatɨ mekaneukakɨne haapa Peripe mɨkɨ tewi mɨhɨritɨarie kaniuka'ɨya.
Haapa me'anatikɨneku Ti'aitame 'Iyarieya Peripe kanitihana. Tewi mɨhɨritɨarie tawariri pɨka'ixei, yutemawietɨ yuhuyeta kaniumiekaitɨni.
Matsi Peripe 'Atsutu paitɨ kaniuyeikakaitɨni, niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne kanikuxatakaitɨni naitsarie kuyeikatɨ kiekaritetsie, 'arike peta'a Tsetsareya paitɨ.
